scope: Read-only triage of three external lexer perf failures; no Rust tests/builds or source edits were run.
candidate_patch_check: git apply --check passed against an isolated /tmp copy of the three source files; no repository files were patched.

jim_oracle.source_basis: jim.c JimParserInit stores the source pointer unchanged; JimParseScript has no BOM case and dispatches this first byte through JimParseStr. tcl-dialect GRAMMAR_JIM also declares script_skips_leading_bom=false. This confirms root token offset 0 is correct for Jim; the test's offset 3 expectation imports C Tcl file behavior.
jim_oracle.test_disposition: narrow expectation correction only: assert Jim root/body token starts at 0 and their source values match; retain the selected Jim grammar/foreign grammar guards.

c_tcl_original_word_witness.scope: Tcl info frame reports the caller's original command text, retaining the quoted word delimiter. The exact byte extent assertion is governed by NativeWord::bytes/try_text, which returns the original operand including quotes; the synthetic selected FirstClose configuration is not claimed to be a C release profile.
c_tcl_original_word_witness.test_disposition: for each loop value, compare word.try_text() with written; unquoted written equals operand, quoted written retains the outer quote pair.

failures.classification: fixture expectation; production behavior matches pinned Jim source and interpreter
failures.evidence: pinned Jim 0.84 treats UTF-8 BOM as ordinary first-command bytes; GRAMMAR_JIM script_skips_leading_bom=false
failures.proposed_change: expect root token source start 0 and root/body values equal

failures.evidence: WordSpan.tokens is an exclusive range. The fixture sets len..len (empty), while written_span uses only end-1 and borrows the previous token; word_job then returns valid geometry instead of WordJob::Unavailable / SourceGeometry.
failures.proposed_change: written_span obtains the final token via tokens.get(word.tokens.clone())?.last()?; retain the original is_err assertions. Candidate patch is stored alongside this receipt.

failures.classification: fixture expectation; source-preserving word bytes match the API contract and C caller-source witness
failures.evidence: NativeWord::bytes returns the original operand and documents that it includes braces or quotes; the test compares both bracket-only and quoted written inputs to the unquoted operand.
failures.proposed_change: compare word.try_text() with the loop's written source in each case; preserve the selected FirstClose/Tcl9Nesting assertions.

limitations: No lexer tests were run; perf failure details and locations came from the coordinator-provided completed run.
The C Tcl info-frame witness retains complete caller command text, not a direct Tcl_ParseCommand token span; NativeWord's source contract supplies that exact span interpretation.
No canonical production/test files were changed.
